prompt:
A short task. Think it through as much as you like.
Each item below shows a sequence of symbols. Pick a single character that would extend this sequence. You may be creative, but give a reason.
For each item, answer with:
  - "next": the single character you pick
  - "why": your reason, briefly
Any symbol may come next, whether it is shown or not; it may have no name.
Judge each item on its own rather than building a scheme across items.

Items:
{"id": 0, "s": ["→", "⇒", "⇉", "⇛", "⇶", "⟹"]}
{"id": 1, "s": ["🚶", "🚲", "🚗"]}
{"id": 2, "s": ["🥡", "🥢", "🥣"]}

Reply with JSON only, no prose: {"answers": [ ... ]}, one entry per item, each {"id": <id>, "next": "<symbol>", "why": "..."}.
